Hough, 41, shared in the film, streaming now on Disney+, that dance became his “safe haven” growing up in Utah.

“Derek was my only boy, and he was a bundle of energy. Derek went on to seemingly allude to one person sexually abusing him. “And then one of my neighbors was, for lack of a better word, just really inappropriate with me physically,” he said.

Amy Sussman/Getty Images

items.title: Man Charged With Murder in Shooting of Texas Mom of 4 on Her 35th Birthday
items.summary:
A man was arrested in the killing of a Texas woman who was fatally shot along a freeway while driving home from work on her 35th birthday.

Juan Gonzalez-Orduna was booked in jail on a murder charge on Sunday, November 22, in connection with the November 15 death of Stephanie Gonzalez , the Dallas Police Department said in a new statement .

Gonzalez was shot after she had been involved in a crash on the C.F. Hawn Freeway in Dallas the evening of November 15, police said in an initial statement. She died of her injuries at a hospital.

Before Gonzalez-Orduna’s arrest, Gonzalez’s family said they believed she had been targeted because of the timing of the killing, which occurred on her birthday as she headed home to her four children.

Man Told Texas Cops He Killed His Wife So He Could Start a 'New Life' With GF 

Gonzalez’s cousin Vivian Britton told NBC DFW that Gonzalez had been about 10 minutes away from her house when she was killed after a day of work at Quality Sausage Company in West Dallas, where she was a company supervisor.

“She was on her way home to see her babies,” Britton said of Gonzalez’s children, which includes a baby who is just a few months old.

Gonzalez-Orduna, 29, has been detained at the Lew Sterrett Jail, where he’s also being held on an immigration hold over his alleged illegal immigration status, records show.

It wasn’t immediately clear whether Gonzalez-Orduna had an attorney who could comment on his behalf.

Dallas police haven’t specified a potential motive for Gonzalez’s killing.

Gonzalez “was a loving daughter, wife, mother, sister, aunt,…

items.title: 'Law & Order' Alum E.J. Carroll's Cause of Death Revealed After Collapse
items.summary:
Law & Order alum E.J. Carroll ’s cause of death has been revealed after he collapsed in the streets of New York City on his way to a voiceover job.

Carroll died of a pulmonary embolism, his manager, Jon Mason , confirmed to Us . He was 66.

Us understands that Carroll recently underwent major surgery to correct a hernia issue. He had taken great lengths to improve his health before his death, including weight loss throughout his career.

Carroll was recovering from his surgery while on his way to a voiceover gig to add dialogue to a commercial he recently filmed with New York Knicks player Jalen Brunson and actress Quinta Brunson . He collapsed on the street en route to the job on Thursday, November 19.

A memorial service will be held in NYC on December 5.

Celebrity Deaths of 2026: E.J. Carroll, Lance Broadway and More 

Mason confirmed Carroll’s death in a statement shared on Saturday, November 21.

“When E.J. Carroll performed, it was impossible to take your eyes off him,” he said. “But his lasting legacy will be the kindness and generosity he showed his friends, fellow performers and even strangers.”

Mason added that Carroll was “as good a human being as it gets.”

Carroll’s close friend Jayce Bartok remembered the actor in a statement to Us after working together on the upcoming film A Delicate Arrangement .

“E.J. was my closest friend for the past 20 years. I met him on the set of a film I wrote, The Cake Eaters starring Kristen Stewart and Bruce Dern. I was preparing for a very dramatic scene, and E.J. and I shared a van. He was so sweet and genuine, he became…
items.t: 'Law & Order' Alum E.J. Carroll's Cause of Death Revealed After Collapse

items.summary:
The R&B Tour has been anything but smooth sailing for Chris Brown and Usher behind the scenes.

“There has been tension between Chris and Usher throughout the tour,” a source exclusively tells Us . “Their teams tried to keep it under lock and key, but everyone knew it was only a matter of time until it became public.”

“We’re likely moving to Nashville,” Mary, 46, told TMZ on Friday, November 20. “The real estate market here is horrible.”

Mary noted that after 25 years in Los Angeles, she was looking for a “more peaceful life.” She also cited her work with animal rescues and how it influenced her lifestyle. 

“I’m not good at just sitting idle and although I’m not sitting with the dogs, I need more land because I have a lot of them,” she said. “We’ve had 13 at one point.”

items.title: Sharna Burgess Claims 'DWTS' Fans Use Votes to 'Manipulate the Show'

Sharna Burgess made a strong statement about the Dancing With the Stars voting system days before the season 35 finale.

In a recent Instagram Story, Burgess, 41, replied to a fan who asked whether she was surprised when Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson were sent home during the semifinals.

“Sadly no, I felt it was going to be another shock elimination,” Burgess wrote. “Not because they deserved it but simply because the online discourse is so wild that [it] was pretty clear who fans were ‘voting off’ and how they have felt about dance experience contestants.”

Burgess continued, “[It’s] so disappointing to see our voting system is now being used by viewers to vote people off instead of voting for your favorite. I say we got [sic] back to yall only have 10 votes total and you have to figure out how to dish them out.”

Harry Shum Jr. Reacts to 'DWTS' Elimination, 'Bullying' Throughout Season 

According to Burgess, “This voting ppl off thing is so insanely negative and not what we are built on and it’s seemingly given fans the chance to manipulate the show. JMO.”
